.orderedSame :\n                             device1.isAvailable ? .orderedAscending : .orderedDescending\n            case .deviceType:\n                comparison = device1.deviceTypeName.compare(device2.deviceTypeName)\n            case .runtimeVersion:\n                let runtime1 = runtimeVersion(for: device1)\n                let runtime2 = runtimeVersion(for: device2)\n                comparison = runtime1.compare(runtime2)\n            }\n            \n            if sortOrder == .ascending {\n                return comparison == .orderedAscending\n            } else {\n                return comparison == .orderedDescending\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Device Info Helpers\n    \n    func runtimeVersion(for device: SimDevice) -&gt; String {\n        guard let runtimeId = device.runtimeIdentifier,\n              let runtime = runtimes[runtimeId] else {\n            return \"Unknown\"\n        }\n        return runtime.name\n    }\n    \n    func deviceTypeName(for device: SimDevice) -&gt; String {\n        if let deviceType = deviceTypes[device.deviceTypeIdentifier] {\n            return deviceType.name\n        }\n        return device.deviceTypeName\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Actions\n    \n    func cloneDevice(udid: String, name: String) async throws {\n        try await service.cloneDevice(udid: udid, name: name)\n        await refreshDevices()\n    }\n    \n    func deleteDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        try await service.deleteDevice(udid: udid)",

        "contents": "}\n\n// MARK: - Device\nstruct SimDevice: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let lastBootedAt: String?\n    let dataPath: String\n    let dataPathSize: Int\n    let logPath: String\n    let udid: String\n    let isAvailable: Bool\n    let logPathSize: Int?\n    let deviceTypeIdentifier: String\n    let state: DeviceState\n    let name: String\n    \n    // Runtime identifier will be set when flattening devices\n    var runtimeIdentifier: String?\n    \n    var id: String { udid }\n    \n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case lastBootedAt, dataPath, dataPathSize, logPath, udid, isAvailable\n        case logPathSize, deviceTypeIdentifier, state, name\n    }\n    \n    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        lastBootedAt = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .lastBootedAt)\n        dataPath = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .dataPath)\n        dataPathSize = try container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .dataPathSize)\n        logPath = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .logPath)\n        udid = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .udid)\n        isAvailable = try container.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .isAvailable)\n        logPathSize = try? container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .logPathSize)\n        deviceTypeIdentifier = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .deviceTypeIdentifier)\n        \n        let stateString = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .state)\n        state = DeviceState(rawValue: stateString) ?? .shutdown\n        \n        name = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .name)\n        runtimeIdentifier = nil\n    }\n    \n    // Helper computed properties\n    var isBooted: Bool {\n        state == .booted\n    }\n    \n    var firmwareVersion: String {\n        // Will be populated from runtime info\n        runtimeIdentifier?.replacingOccurrences(of: \"com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.\", with: \"\").replacingOccurrences(of: \"-\", with: \" \") ??         "contents": "            }\n            \n            do {\n                try process.run()\n                \n                // Set timeout\n                Task {\n                    try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 30_000_000_000) // 30 seconds\n                    if process.isRunning &amp;&amp; !hasResumed {\n                        process.terminate()\n                        resumeOnce(.failure(SimctlError.commandFailed(\"Command timed out after 30 seconds\")))\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch {\n                resumeOnce(.failure(error))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Fetch Device List\n    \n    func fetchDeviceList() async throws -&gt; SimctlListResponse {\n        let result = try await executeCommand([\"list\", \"-j\"])\n        \n        guard let data = result.output.data(using: .utf8) else {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidJSON\n        }\n        \n        let decoder = JSONDecoder()\n        let response = try decoder.decode(SimctlListResponse.self, from: data)\n        \n        return response\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Clone Device\n    \n    func cloneDevice(udid: String, name: String) async throws {\n        guard !name.isEmpty else {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidDeviceName\n        }\n        \n        // Validate name doesn't contain invalid characters\n        let invalidCharacters = CharacterSet(charactersIn: \"\\\"\\\\\")\n        if name.rangeOfCharacter(from: invalidCharacters) != nil {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidDeviceName\n        }\n        \n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"clone\", udid, name])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Delete Device\n    \n    func deleteDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"delete\", udid])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Boot Device\n    \n    func bootDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"boot\", udid])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Shutdown Device\n    \n    func shutdownDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"shutdown\", udid])\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "//\n//  SimctlModels.swift\n//  SimctlHelperUI\n//\n//  Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 09.02.26.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\n\n// MARK: - Root Response\nstruct SimctlListResponse: Codable {\n    let devicetypes: [SimDeviceType]\n    let runtimes: [SimRuntime]\n    let devices: [String: [SimDevice]]\n    let pairs: [String: AnyCodable]?\n    \n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case devicetypes, runtimes, devices, pairs\n    }\n    \n    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        devicetypes = try container.decode([SimDeviceType].self, forKey: .devicetypes)\n        runtimes = try container.decode([SimRuntime].self, forKey: .runtimes)\n        devices = try container.decode([String: [SimDevice]].self, forKey: .devices)\n        pairs = try? container.decode([String: AnyCodable].self, forKey: .pairs)\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Device Type\nstruct SimDeviceType: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let productFamily: String\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let maxRuntimeVersion: Int\n    let maxRuntimeVersionString: String\n    let identifier: String\n    let modelIdentifier: String\n    let minRuntimeVersionString: String\n    let minRuntimeVersion: Int\n    let name: String\n    \n    var id: String { identifier }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Runtime\nstruct SimRuntime: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let isAvailable: Bool\n    let version: String\n    let isInternal: Bool\n    let buildversion: String\n    let supportedArchitectures: [String]\n    let supportedDeviceTypes: [SimDeviceTypeReference]\n    let identifier: String\n    let platform: String\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let runtimeRoot: String\n    let lastUsage: [String: String]?\n    let name: String\n    \n    var id: String { identifier }\n}\n\nstruct SimDeviceTypeReference: Codable {\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let name: String\n    let identifier: String\n    let productFamily: String\n}\n\n// MARK: - Device\nstruct SimDevice: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let lastBootedAt: String?\n    let dataPath: String\n    let dataPathSize: Int",

Create Data Models (&#96;SimctlModels.swift&#96;)\n\nCreate Swift structs matching the JSON structure:\n\n- &#96;SimctlListResponse&#96;: Root response with devicetypes, runtimes, devices, pairs\n- &#96;SimDevice&#96;: Individual device with all properties\n- &#96;SimRuntime&#96;: Runtime information (iOS version, etc.)\n- &#96;SimDeviceType&#96;: Device type information\n- Helper computed properties for display (firmware version, device type name)\n\n### 2. Create Simctl Service (&#96;SimctlService.swift&#96;)\n\nService class to execute &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands:\n\n- &#96;fetchDeviceList()&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl list -j&#96;, parses JSON, returns &#96;SimctlListResponse&#96;\n- &#96;cloneDevice(udid:name:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl clone &lt;udid&gt; &lt;name&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;deleteDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl delete &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;bootDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl boot &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;shutdownDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl shutdown &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- Error handling for command execution failures\n\n### 3. Create ViewModel (&#96;DeviceListViewModel.swift&#96;)\n\nObservable class managing device list state:\n\n- &#96;@Published var devices: [SimDevice]&#96;: Flattened list of all devices\n- &#96;@Published var isLoading: Bool&#96;: Loading state\n- &#96;@Published var errorMessage: String?&#96;: Error handling\n- &#96;@Published var sortKey: SortKey&#96;: Current sort column\n- &#96;@Published var sortOrder: SortOrder&#96;: Ascending/descending\n- &#96;selectedDevice: SimDevice?&#96;: Currently selected device\n- Methods: &#96;loadDevices()&#96;, &#96;refreshDevices()&#96;, &#96;cloneDevice()&#96;, &#96;deleteDevice()&#96;, &#96;bootDevice()&#96;, &#96;shutdownDevice()&#96;\n- Sorting logic for different columns\n\n### 4.       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/simctl_gui_implementation_a6766595.plan.md",
        "range": {

        "contents": "---\nname: Simctl GUI Implementation\noverview: Build a macOS SwiftUI app that wraps xcrun simctl commands, providing a GUI for listing, cloning, deleting, and booting/shutting down iOS simulators with sortable device information.\ntodos:\n  - id: \"1\"\n    content: Create SimctlModels.swift with Codable structs for JSON parsing (SimctlListResponse, SimDevice, SimRuntime, SimDeviceType)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"2\"\n    content: Create SimctlService.swift with methods to execute xcrun simctl commands (list, clone, delete, boot, shutdown)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"3\"\n    content: Create DeviceListViewModel.swift with @Published properties, sorting logic, and action methods\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"4\"\n    content: Update ContentView.swift with Table view showing devices, sortable columns, and selection handling\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"5\"\n    content: Create DeviceActionsView.swift for displaying selected device actions (clone, delete, boot/shutdown)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"6\"\n    content: Create CloneDeviceView.swift modal for entering new device name when cloning\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"7\"\n    content: Update app configuration if needed (sandbox settings for xcrun command execution)\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# SimctlHelperUI Implementation Plan\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\nThe app will use a Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture with:\n\n- **Models**: Device data structures matching the JSON format from &#96;xcrun simctl list -j&#96;\n- **Service Layer**: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands and parses JSON responses\n- **ViewModels**: Manages device list state, sorting, and actions\n- **Views**: SwiftUI interface for displaying devices and actions\n\n## Data Structure\n\nBased on the JSON format, devices are organized by runtime (iOS/watchOS versions). Each device contains:\n\n- &#96;udid&#96;: Unique device identifier\n- &#96;name&#96;: Device name\n- &#96;state&#96;: \"Booted\" or \"Shutdown\"\n- &#96;isAvailable&#96;: Boolean availability status\n- &#96;deviceTypeIdentifier&#96;: Links to device type info\n- &#96;runtimeIdentifier&#96;: Derived from the parent runtime key",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# SimctlHelperUI Implementation Plan",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## Architecture Overview",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "The app will use a Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture with:",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Models**: Device data structures matching the JSON format from &#96;xcrun simctl list -j&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Service Layer**: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands and parses JSON responses",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ViewModels**: Manages device list state, sorting, and actions",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Views**: SwiftUI interface for displaying devices and actions",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "## Data Structure",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "Based on the JSON format, devices are organized by runtime (iOS/watchOS versions). Each device contains:",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;udid&#96;: Unique device identifier",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;name&#96;: Device name",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;state&#96;: \"Booted\" or \"Shutdown\"",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;isAvailable&#96;: Boolean availability status",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;deviceTypeIdentifier&#96;: Links to device type info",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;runtimeIdentifier&#96;: Derived from the parent runtime key",
            "lineNumber": 49
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.16308610141277313
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/simctl_gui_implementation_a6766595.plan.md",

        "contents": "- Table/List view showing devices with columns:\n  - Name\n  - State (Booted/Shutdown) with visual indicator\n  - Availability (Available/Unavailable)\n  - Device Type (e.g., \"iPhone 17 Pro\")\n  - Runtime/Firmware Version (e.g., \"iOS 26.2\")\n- Sortable column headers\n- Selection handling\n- Action buttons (Clone, Delete, Boot/Shutdown) enabled when device selected\n\n### 5. Create Device Detail/Actions View (&#96;DeviceActionsView.swift&#96;)\n\nSidebar or bottom panel showing:\n\n- Selected device details\n- Action buttons:\n  - Clone button → shows text field for new name → executes clone\n  - Delete button → shows confirmation dialog → executes delete\n  - Boot/Shutdown toggle button (shows \"Boot\" if shutdown, \"Shutdown\" if booted)\n\n### 6. Create Clone Dialog (&#96;CloneDeviceView.swift&#96;)\n\nModal sheet or alert for cloning:\n\n- Text field for new device name\n- Validation (non-empty, unique name)\n- Cancel/Clone buttons\n\n### 7. Update App Configuration\n\nEnsure app has necessary entitlements:\n\n- May need to disable App Sandbox or add specific entitlements to execute &#96;xcrun&#96; commands\n- Check if &#96;ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX = YES&#96; needs to be changed\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nSimctlHelperUI/\n├── SimctlHelperUIApp.swift (existing)\n├── ContentView.swift (replace)\n├── Models/\n│   └── SimctlModels.swift (new)\n├── Services/\n│   └── SimctlService.swift (new)\n├── ViewModels/\n│   └── DeviceListViewModel.swift (new)\n└── Views/\n    ├── DeviceActionsView.swift (new)\n    └── CloneDeviceView.swift (new)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Implementation Details\n\n### JSON Parsing\n\n- Use &#96;JSONDecoder&#96; with &#96;Codable&#96; protocols\n- Handle nested structure: devices grouped by runtime identifier\n- Flatten devices array for display while preserving runtime info\n\n### Command Execution\n\n- Use &#96;Process&#96; API to execute &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands\n- Parse stdout/stderr for success/error\n- Handle cases where commands fail (device already booted, doesn't exist, etc.)\n\n### UI/UX Considerations\n\n- Show loading indicator while fetching device list",

        "contents": "            .padding()\n            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)\n        }\n        .sheet(isPresented: $showCloneDialog) {\n            if let device = viewModel.selectedDevice {\n                CloneDeviceView(\n                    isPresented: $showCloneDialog,\n                    deviceName: device.name\n                ) { newName in\n                    try await viewModel.cloneDevice(udid: device.udid, name: newName)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .alert(\"Delete Device\", isPresented: $showDeleteConfirmation) {\n            Button(\"Cancel\", role: .cancel) {}\n            Button(\"Delete\", role: .destructive) {\n                deleteDevice()\n            }\n        } message: {\n            if let device = viewModel.selectedDevice {\n                Text(\"Are you sure you want to delete \\\"\\(device.name)\\\"? This action cannot be undone.\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func toggleBootState() {\n        guard let device = viewModel.selectedDevice else { return }\n        \n        isPerformingAction = true\n        actionError = nil\n        \n        Task {\n            do {\n                if device.isBooted {\n                    try await viewModel.shutdownDevice(udid: device.udid)\n                } else {\n                    try await viewModel.bootDevice(udid: device.udid)\n                }\n            } catch {\n                actionError = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n            isPerformingAction = false\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func deleteDevice() {\n        guard let device = viewModel.selectedDevice else { return }\n        \n        isPerformingAction = true\n        actionError = nil\n        \n        Task {\n            do {\n                try await viewModel.deleteDevice(udid: device.udid)\n            } catch {\n                actionError = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n            isPerformingAction = false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct InfoRow: View {\n    let label: String\n    let value: String\n    ",

        "contents": "//\n//  CloneDeviceView.swift\n//  SimctlHelperUI\n//\n//  Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 09.02.26.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CloneDeviceView: View {\n    @Binding var isPresented: Bool\n    let deviceName: String\n    let onClone: (String) async throws -&gt; Void\n    \n    @State private var newName: String = \"\"\n    @State private var isCloning: Bool = false\n    @State private var errorMessage: String?\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 20) {\n            Text(\"Clone Device\")\n                .font(.headline)\n            \n            Text(\"Clone \\\"\\(deviceName)\\\"\")\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n            \n            TextField(\"New device name\", text: $newName)\n                .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)\n                .onSubmit {\n                    if isValid {\n                        cloneDevice()\n                    }\n                }\n            \n            if let errorMessage = errorMessage {\n                Text(errorMessage)\n                    .foregroundColor(.red)\n                    .font(.caption)\n            }\n            \n            HStack {\n                Button(\"Cancel\") {\n                    isPresented = false\n                }\n                .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)\n                \n                Button(\"Clone\") {\n                    cloneDevice()\n                }\n                .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)\n                .disabled(!isValid || isCloning)\n            }\n        }\n        .padding()\n        .frame(width: 400)\n        .onAppear {\n            newName = \"\\(deviceName) Copy\"\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var isValid: Bool {\n        !newName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty\n    }\n    \n    private func cloneDevice() {\n        guard isValid else { return }",

container.decode(String.self, forKey: .lastBootedAt)\n        dataPath = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .dataPath)\n        dataPathSize = try container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .dataPathSize)\n        logPath = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .logPath)\n        udid = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .udid)\n        isAvailable = try container.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .isAvailable)\n        logPathSize = try? .shutdown\n        \n        name = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .name)\n        runtimeIdentifier = nil\n    }\n    \n    // Helper computed properties\n    var isBooted: Bool {\n        state == .booted\n    }\n    \n    var firmwareVersion: String {\n        // Will be populated from runtime info\n        runtimeIdentifier?.replacingOccurrences(of: \"com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.\", with: \"\").replacingOccurrences(of: \"-\", with: \" \") ??         "contents": "//\n//  CloneDeviceView.swift\n//  SimctlHelperUI\n//\n//  Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 09.02.26.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CloneDeviceView: View {\n    @Binding var isPresented: Bool\n    let deviceName: String\n    let onClone: (String) async throws -&gt; Void\n    \n    @State private var newName: String = \"\"\n    @State private var isCloning: Bool = false\n    @State private var errorMessage: String?\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 20) {\n            Text(\"Clone Device\")\n                .font(.headline)\n            \n            Text(\"Clone \\\"\\(deviceName)\\\"\")\n                .font(.subheadline)\n                .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n            \n            TextField(\"New device name\", text: $newName)\n                .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)\n                .onSubmit {\n                    if isValid {\n                        cloneDevice()\n                    }\n                }\n            \n            if let errorMessage = errorMessage {\n                Text(errorMessage)\n                    .foregroundColor(.red)\n                    .font(.caption)\n            }\n            \n            HStack {\n                Button(\"Cancel\") {\n                    isPresented = false\n                }\n                .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)\n                \n                Button(\"Clone\") {\n                    cloneDevice()\n                }\n                .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)\n                .disabled(!isValid || isCloning)\n            }\n        }\n        .padding()\n        .frame(width: 400)\n        .onAppear {\n            newName = \"\\(deviceName) Copy\"\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private var isValid: Bool {\n        !newName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty\n    }\n    \n    private func cloneDevice() {\n        guard isValid else { return }",

        "contents": "}\n        applySorting()\n    }\n    \n    private func applySorting() {\n        devices.sort { device1, device2 in\n            let comparison: ComparisonResult\n            \n            switch sortKey {\n            case .name:\n                comparison = device1.name.compare(device2.name)\n            case .state:\n                comparison = device1.state.rawValue.compare(device2.state.rawValue)\n            case .availability:\n                comparison = device1.isAvailable == device2.isAvailable ? .orderedSame :\n                             device1.isAvailable ? .orderedAscending : .orderedDescending\n            case .deviceType:\n                comparison = device1.deviceTypeName.compare(device2.deviceTypeName)\n            case .runtimeVersion:\n                let runtime1 = runtimeVersion(for: device1)\n                let runtime2 = runtimeVersion(for: device2)\n                comparison = runtime1.compare(runtime2)\n            }\n            \n            if sortOrder == .ascending {\n                return comparison == .orderedAscending\n            } else {\n                return comparison == .orderedDescending\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Device Info Helpers\n    \n    func runtimeVersion(for device: SimDevice) -&gt; String {\n        guard let runtimeId = device.runtimeIdentifier,\n              let runtime = runtimes[runtimeId] else {\n            return \"Unknown\"\n        }\n        return runtime.name\n    }\n    \n    func deviceTypeName(for device: SimDevice) -&gt; String {\n        if let deviceType = deviceTypes[device.deviceTypeIdentifier] {\n            return deviceType.name\n        }\n        return device.deviceTypeName\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Actions\n    \n    func cloneDevice(udid: String, name: String) async throws {\n        try await service.cloneDevice(udid: udid, name: name)\n        await refreshDevices()\n    }\n    \n    func deleteDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        try await service.deleteDevice(udid: udid)",

        "contents": "- Table/List view showing devices with columns:\n  - Name\n  - State (Booted/Shutdown) with visual indicator\n  - Availability (Available/Unavailable)\n  - Device Type (e.g., \"iPhone 17 Pro\")\n  - Runtime/Firmware Version (e.g., \"iOS 26.2\")\n- Sortable column headers\n- Selection handling\n- Action buttons (Clone, Delete, Boot/Shutdown) enabled when device selected\n\n### 5. Create Device Detail/Actions View (&#96;DeviceActionsView.swift&#96;)\n\nSidebar or bottom panel showing:\n\n- Selected device details\n- Action buttons:\n  - Clone button → shows text field for new name → executes clone\n  - Delete button → shows confirmation dialog → executes delete\n  - Boot/Shutdown toggle button (shows \"Boot\" if shutdown, \"Shutdown\" if booted)\n\n### 6. Create Clone Dialog (&#96;CloneDeviceView.swift&#96;)\n\nModal sheet or alert for cloning:\n\n- Text field for new device name\n- Validation (non-empty, unique name)\n- Cancel/Clone buttons\n\n### 7. Update App Configuration\n\nEnsure app has necessary entitlements:\n\n- May need to disable App Sandbox or add specific entitlements to execute &#96;xcrun&#96; commands\n- Check if &#96;ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX = YES&#96; needs to be changed\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nSimctlHelperUI/\n├── SimctlHelperUIApp.swift (existing)\n├── ContentView.swift (replace)\n├── Models/\n│   └── SimctlModels.swift (new)\n├── Services/\n│   └── SimctlService.swift (new)\n├── ViewModels/\n│   └── DeviceListViewModel.swift (new)\n└── Views/\n    ├── DeviceActionsView.swift (new)\n    └── CloneDeviceView.swift (new)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Implementation Details\n\n### JSON Parsing\n\n- Use &#96;JSONDecoder&#96; with &#96;Codable&#96; protocols\n- Handle nested structure: devices grouped by runtime identifier\n- Flatten devices array for display while preserving runtime info\n\n### Command Execution\n\n- Use &#96;Process&#96; API to execute &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands\n- Parse stdout/stderr for success/error\n- Handle cases where commands fail (device already booted, doesn't exist, etc.)\n\n### UI/UX Considerations\n\n- Show loading indicator while fetching device list",

        "contents": "            }\n            \n            do {\n                try process.run()\n                \n                // Set timeout\n                Task {\n                    try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 30_000_000_000) // 30 seconds\n                    if process.isRunning &amp;&amp; !hasResumed {\n                        process.terminate()\n                        resumeOnce(.failure(SimctlError.commandFailed(\"Command timed out after 30 seconds\")))\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch {\n                resumeOnce(.failure(error))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Fetch Device List\n    \n    func fetchDeviceList() async throws -&gt; SimctlListResponse {\n        let result = try await executeCommand([\"list\", \"-j\"])\n        \n        guard let data = result.output.data(using: .utf8) else {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidJSON\n        }\n        \n        let decoder = JSONDecoder()\n        let response = try decoder.decode(SimctlListResponse.self, from: data)\n        \n        return response\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Clone Device\n    \n    func cloneDevice(udid: String, name: String) async throws {\n        guard !name.isEmpty else {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidDeviceName\n        }\n        \n        // Validate name doesn't contain invalid characters\n        let invalidCharacters = CharacterSet(charactersIn: \"\\\"\\\\\")\n        if name.rangeOfCharacter(from: invalidCharacters) != nil {\n            throw SimctlError.invalidDeviceName\n        }\n        \n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"clone\", udid, name])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Delete Device\n    \n    func deleteDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"delete\", udid])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Boot Device\n    \n    func bootDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"boot\", udid])\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Shutdown Device\n    \n    func shutdownDevice(udid: String) async throws {\n        _ = try await executeCommand([\"shutdown\", udid])\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "### UI/UX Considerations\n\n- Show loading indicator while fetching device list\n- Display error messages for failed operations\n- Auto-refresh device list after clone/delete operations\n- Disable actions appropriately (e.g., can't boot already booted device)\n- Visual indicators for device state (color coding)\n\n### Sorting\n\n- Support sorting by: Name, State, Availability, Device Type, Runtime Version\n- Toggle ascending/descending on column header click\n- Maintain sort state across refreshes\n\n## Testing Considerations\n\n- Test with various device states (booted, shutdown, unavailable)\n- Test error cases (device not found, invalid names, etc.)\n- Test sorting functionality\n- Verify command execution works correctly",

        "contents": "---\nname: Simctl GUI Implementation\noverview: Build a macOS SwiftUI app that wraps xcrun simctl commands, providing a GUI for listing, cloning, deleting, and booting/shutting down iOS simulators with sortable device information.\ntodos:\n  - id: \"1\"\n    content: Create SimctlModels.swift with Codable structs for JSON parsing (SimctlListResponse, SimDevice, SimRuntime, SimDeviceType)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"2\"\n    content: Create SimctlService.swift with methods to execute xcrun simctl commands (list, clone, delete, boot, shutdown)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"3\"\n    content: Create DeviceListViewModel.swift with @Published properties, sorting logic, and action methods\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"4\"\n    content: Update ContentView.swift with Table view showing devices, sortable columns, and selection handling\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"5\"\n    content: Create DeviceActionsView.swift for displaying selected device actions (clone, delete, boot/shutdown)\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"6\"\n    content: Create CloneDeviceView.swift modal for entering new device name when cloning\n    status: completed\n  - id: \"7\"\n    content: Update app configuration if needed (sandbox settings for xcrun command execution)\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# SimctlHelperUI Implementation Plan\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\nThe app will use a Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture with:\n\n- **Models**: Device data structures matching the JSON format from &#96;xcrun simctl list -j&#96;\n- **Service Layer**: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands and parses JSON responses\n- **ViewModels**: Manages device list state, sorting, and actions\n- **Views**: SwiftUI interface for displaying devices and actions\n\n## Data Structure\n\nBased on the JSON format, devices are organized by runtime (iOS/watchOS versions). Each device contains:\n\n- &#96;udid&#96;: Unique device identifier\n- &#96;name&#96;: Device name\n- &#96;state&#96;: \"Booted\" or \"Shutdown\"\n- &#96;isAvailable&#96;: Boolean availability status\n- &#96;deviceTypeIdentifier&#96;: Links to device type info\n- &#96;runtimeIdentifier&#96;: Derived from the parent runtime key",

        "contents": "            .padding()\n            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)\n        }\n        .sheet(isPresented: $showCloneDialog) {\n            if let device = viewModel.selectedDevice {\n                CloneDeviceView(\n                    isPresented: $showCloneDialog,\n                    deviceName: device.name\n                ) { newName in\n                    try await viewModel.cloneDevice(udid: device.udid, name: newName)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .alert(\"Delete Device\", isPresented: $showDeleteConfirmation) {\n            Button(\"Cancel\", role: .cancel) {}\n            Button(\"Delete\", role: .destructive) {\n                deleteDevice()\n            }\n        } message: {\n            if let device = viewModel.selectedDevice {\n                Text(\"Are you sure you want to delete \\\"\\(device.name)\\\"? This action cannot be undone.\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func toggleBootState() {\n        guard let device = viewModel.selectedDevice else { return }\n        \n        isPerformingAction = true\n        actionError = nil\n        \n        Task {\n            do {\n                if device.isBooted {\n                    try await viewModel.shutdownDevice(udid: device.udid)\n                } else {\n                    try await viewModel.bootDevice(udid: device.udid)\n                }\n            } catch {\n                actionError = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n            isPerformingAction = false\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func deleteDevice() {\n        guard let device = viewModel.selectedDevice else { return }\n        \n        isPerformingAction = true\n        actionError = nil\n        \n        Task {\n            do {\n                try await viewModel.deleteDevice(udid: device.udid)\n            } catch {\n                actionError = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n            isPerformingAction = false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct InfoRow: View {\n    let label: String\n    let value: String\n    ",

        "contents": "//\n//  SimctlModels.swift\n//  SimctlHelperUI\n//\n//  Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 09.02.26.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\n\n// MARK: - Root Response\nstruct SimctlListResponse: Codable {\n    let devicetypes: [SimDeviceType]\n    let runtimes: [SimRuntime]\n    let devices: [String: [SimDevice]]\n    let pairs: [String: AnyCodable]?\n    \n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case devicetypes, runtimes, devices, pairs\n    }\n    \n    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        devicetypes = try container.decode([SimDeviceType].self, forKey: .devicetypes)\n        runtimes = try container.decode([SimRuntime].self, forKey: .runtimes)\n        devices = try container.decode([String: [SimDevice]].self, forKey: .devices)\n        pairs = try? container.decode([String: AnyCodable].self, forKey: .pairs)\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Device Type\nstruct SimDeviceType: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let productFamily: String\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let maxRuntimeVersion: Int\n    let maxRuntimeVersionString: String\n    let identifier: String\n    let modelIdentifier: String\n    let minRuntimeVersionString: String\n    let minRuntimeVersion: Int\n    let name: String\n    \n    var id: String { identifier }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Runtime\nstruct SimRuntime: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let isAvailable: Bool\n    let version: String\n    let isInternal: Bool\n    let buildversion: String\n    let supportedArchitectures: [String]\n    let supportedDeviceTypes: [SimDeviceTypeReference]\n    let identifier: String\n    let platform: String\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let runtimeRoot: String\n    let lastUsage: [String: String]?\n    let name: String\n    \n    var id: String { identifier }\n}\n\nstruct SimDeviceTypeReference: Codable {\n    let bundlePath: String\n    let name: String\n    let identifier: String\n    let productFamily: String\n}\n\n// MARK: - Device\nstruct SimDevice: Codable, Identifiable {\n    let lastBootedAt: String?\n    let dataPath: String\n    let dataPathSize: Int",

Create Data Models (&#96;SimctlModels.swift&#96;)\n\nCreate Swift structs matching the JSON structure:\n\n- &#96;SimctlListResponse&#96;: Root response with devicetypes, runtimes, devices, pairs\n- &#96;SimDevice&#96;: Individual device with all properties\n- &#96;SimRuntime&#96;: Runtime information (iOS version, etc.)\n- &#96;SimDeviceType&#96;: Device type information\n- Helper computed properties for display (firmware version, device type name)\n\n### 2. Create Simctl Service (&#96;SimctlService.swift&#96;)\n\nService class to execute &#96;xcrun simctl&#96; commands:\n\n- &#96;fetchDeviceList()&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl list -j&#96;, parses JSON, returns &#96;SimctlListResponse&#96;\n- &#96;cloneDevice(udid:name:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl clone &lt;udid&gt; &lt;name&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;deleteDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl delete &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;bootDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl boot &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- &#96;shutdownDevice(udid:)&#96;: Executes &#96;xcrun simctl shutdown &lt;udid&gt;&#96;\n- Error handling for command execution failures\n\n### 3. Create ViewModel (&#96;DeviceListViewModel.swift&#96;)\n\nObservable class managing device list state:\n\n- &#96;@Published var devices: [SimDevice]&#96;: Flattened list of all devices\n- &#96;@Published var isLoading: Bool&#96;: Loading state\n- &#96;@Published var errorMessage: String?&#96;: Error handling\n- &#96;@Published var sortKey: SortKey&#96;: Current sort column\n- &#96;@Published var sortOrder: SortOrder&#96;: Ascending/descending\n- &#96;selectedDevice: SimDevice?&#96;: Currently selected device\n- Methods: &#96;loadDevices()&#96;, &#96;refreshDevices()&#96;, &#96;cloneDevice()&#96;, &#96;deleteDevice()&#96;, &#96;bootDevice()&#96;, &#96;shutdownDevice()&#96;\n- Sorting logic for different columns\n\n### 4. +// Thread-safe data collector for command execution
+final class CommandDataCollector: @unchecked Sendable {
+    private let lock = NSLock()
+    nonisolated(unsafe) private var outputData = Data()
+    nonisolated(unsafe) private var errorData = Data()
+    nonisolated(unsafe) private var hasResumed = false
+    
+    nonisolated func appendOutput(_ data: Data) {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        outputData.append(data)
+    }
+    
+    nonisolated func appendError(_ data: Data) {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        errorData.append(data)
+    }
+    
+    nonisolated func finalize(remainingOutput: Data, remainingError: Data) -&gt; (output: String, error: String) {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        if !remainingOutput.isEmpty {
+            outputData.append(remainingOutput)
+        }
+        if !remainingError.isEmpty {
+            errorData.append(remainingError)
+        }
+        let output = String(data: outputData, encoding: .utf8) ?? ""
+        let error = String(data: errorData, encoding: .utf8) ?? ""
+        return (output: output, error: error)
+    }
+    
+    nonisolated func tryResume() -&gt; Bool {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        if hasResumed {
+            return false
+        }
+        hasResumed = true
+        return true
+    }
+}

Committed the changes. Summary:

## Commit Summary

**Commit**: `Improve device list UX and fix Swift 6 concurrency issues`

### Changes Made:

1. **Device list auto-refresh**: When a device is selected, the list refreshes automatically while preserving the selection.

2. **Name column width**: Extended the Name column to `min: 200, ideal: 250` points to better fit device names.

3. **ProgressView layout fix**: Reduced the loading spinner size (scale 0.6) and constrained its frame (16x16) to prevent layout jumps.

4. **Swift 6 concurrency fixes**: Introduced a thread-safe `CommandDataCollector` class to resolve concurrency errors:
   - Uses `NSLock` to protect shared mutable state
   - Methods marked as `nonisolated` to allow calls from file handle handlers
   - Properly handles concurrent access to command output/error data

5. **Selection preservation**: Device selection is preserved across refresh operations by storing the UDID before refresh and restoring it afterward.

All changes have been committed to the `main` branch.
